Flow Cytometry.sample_type: heparinized whole blood, cryopreserved PBMCs, in vitro stimulated PBMCs
Flow Cytometry.readouts: CD4+ and CD8+ T cell Ki67/Bcl2 responses, CXCR5+CXCR3+ICOS+ Tfh-like CD4+ cells, IFN-γ/IL-4/IL-21-positive CD4+ T cells, innate cell population frequencies including dendritic cells, monocytes, neutrophils and NK cells, CD80/HLA-DR activation, intracellular VZV-gI, IL-6 and IFN-α

Q-PCR.obi_label: real time polymerase chain reaction assay

Transcription profiling by array.readouts: gene expression changes, blood transcription modules, pathway/module activity, PSPH and SREBF1 target signatures

ELISpot.readouts: VZV-specific IFN-γ, IL-4 and IL-21 T cell responses; Zostavax-specific and total IgG B cell/plasmablast responses

ELISA.readouts: VZV glycoprotein-specific IgG, total VZV infected cell lysate IgG, VZV-specific IgA titers

Plasma Metabolomics analysis.readouts: untargeted LC-MS metabolite peaks, differential metabolites, pathway enrichment including TCA cycle, propanoate, inositol phosphate, glycerophospholipid and sterol metabolism

Cytokine Bead Array (CBA).sample_type: cell-free culture supernatants from in vitro stimulated PBMCs
Cytokine Bead Array (CBA).readouts: cytokines and chemokines including IL-6, TNF, CXCL8, CCL2, CXCL9 and CXCL10
Cytokine Bead Array (CBA).obi_label: antibody detection by cytometric bead array assay
